name: pi-simple-agents
description: Minimal subagent delegation for pi. Spawns Claude-Code-compatible agent `.md` files as subprocesses, in single or parallel mode, and blocks until results are ready. No chains, no coordinators, no TUI-heavy orchestration — just run agents and get their ans
